task: Add end-to-end tests for the newsletter signup page (`/`). Acceptance criteria: (1) subscribing with a valid, new email address shows `Thanks, you're subscribed` and the subscriber count under the heading increases (`1 subscriber`, then `N subscribers`); (2) an invalid address shows the error `Enter a valid email address` and is not counted; (3) an address that is already subscribed shows the error `That email is already subscribed` and is not counted twice; (4) pressing Enter in the email field submits exactly like the Subscribe button; (5) the email field is emptied after a successful subscription. The test seam `POST /api/reset` removes every subscriber.

faults.description: A duplicate address is accepted and counted again.
Any non-empty text is accepted as an address.
Enter in the email field does nothing; only the button submits.
The email stays in the field after a successful subscription.
